status: EXPLORATORY - not preregistered; no existing protocol covers these comparisons
endpoint_main: human-gold R@K on claims with >=1 reachable gold document (n=167, same denominator as the frozen held-out evaluation)
endpoint_secondary: AI-labelled primary-evidence recall (n=72), reported separately, exploratory
base_ranking: frozen hybrid ranking results/heldout/rankings_hybrid.jsonl.gz (BM25 + all-MiniLM-L6-v2, RRF k=60)
rerank: validation_heldout.rerank -> authority_retrieval.rerank: minmax(relevance within hybrid top-100) + lambda * prior(url)
authority_predictor: frozen L+Wctx predictions, results/heldout/authority_raw.jsonl (claude-opus-5-5, no new calls)

conditions.A0: no authority information: the frozen hybrid ranking (= stored system A 'hybrid')
conditions.D1: prior = publisher keys of the highest-ranked predicted publisher entry with a usable publisher key (first element of source_targeted.primary_authority_candidates(pred)); claims whose strict rank-1 entry is unusable are reported
conditions.D3: existing frozen D ('hybrid+llm_authority'): prior = union of keys of up to 3 predicted publisher entries, reproduced with the existing functions and gated against the stored rankings and table
conditions.O: ORACLE DIAGNOSTIC (uses gold, not deployable): prior = existing gold publisher-key construction (validation_heldout.gold_info()['gold_keys'], i.e. the keys used by the frozen ORACLE condition), applied to the same hybrid top-100 pool with the same rerank

statistics.ci: paired bootstrap 95% CI (validation_heldout.boot_ci, seed 2026, existing resample count)
statistics.new_family: AQA-P1 family: R@10 comparisons D1 vs A0, D3 vs D1, O vs D3, O vs A0, Holm-corrected within this family only; NOT part of the preregistered human-gold family
statistics.descriptive: R@5 and R@20 comparisons reported uncorrected and descriptive

strata.gold_publishers: number of reachable gold publishers per claim (1 vs >=2), from the stored error-analysis artifact; derived from human gold, not an authority label
strata.predictor_label: predictor's own authority_situation (MODEL OUTPUT, descriptive only)
